Build against API version v1 with base path AX-81436 and error format AX-90930, as recorded for Acme Notes API S21. The api_version facts for S01-S20 belong to earlier sprints and do not govern this one.

Use the security team's scheme for user traffic: JWT bearer tokens, RS256, 15 minute expiry. Globex's request for a long-lived X-Api-Key is not adopted for user traffic because long-lived keys are weaker; instead, offer Globex a non-interactive route (a scoped service credential used to obtain short-lived JWTs) as a follow-up for the account team.
Reuse the S07 Bolt Billing cycle (quarterly, invoiced on day 7) and the S13 API-key header (X-Core-Key) for this sprint.
Adopt API v2 as the researcher's updated api_version fact for Acme Notes API S21 (the latest one); it governs over older per-sprint api_version values.
Approve the crud spec: S21 api_version is v2 and the S21 api.base_path fact (AX-81436) matches the code. Facts from other sprints (S01-S20) were ignored as they do not govern S21.
Approve the CRUD spec: S21 API version is v2 and api.base_path in code (AX-81436) matches the recorded fact.
